note: OSV lists no fix commit; the hunk is in the 4.1.136 merge of many advisories. Http2ToHttpHeaderTranslator.translateHeaders copies a literal host header next to the one built from :authority. The advisory names InboundHttp2ToHttpAdapter and Http2StreamFrameToHttpObjectCodec, which translate headers through HttpConversionUtil. Present in 4.1.42, 4.1.100, 4.1.131 and 4.2.6, and under the io.grpc.netty.shaded prefix in grpc-netty-shaded 1.50.0 and 1.70.0. Reached only where the app translates HTTP/2 to HTTP/1.x objects.
